accepted_algorithm_families: Binary search on a monotone damage predicate
adversarial_cases: A gap equal to k contributes exactly k; no extra second is counted.
Dense attacks with very large h require the full final tail.
Separate test cases must not retain previous attack times.
complexity_ceiling: O(n log(h+1)) time and O(n) space per test case
decisive_facts: Attack times are strictly increasing and lie in [1,10^9].
Each attack refreshes the effect; poison damage does not stack.
k=h is always sufficient because the last attack lasts k seconds.
Authored reasoning is unreviewed smoke data, not formal human ground truth.
key_invariants: D(k) is nondecreasing for positive k.
The minimum feasible k remains in [low,high], and high is feasible.
known_traps: Summing n*k ignores refreshed overlapping poison.
Omitting the final k seconds loses the final attack contribution.
Using a strict damage>h check rejects exact equality.
An off-by-one gap miscounts the attack second.
